# Real Beast art (test and gas fixture)

A real Beast SVG, the art of the full-size Beasts `token_uri` in [`examples/beast_consumer`](../../../examples/beast_consumer) and its gas measurements. It is a test fixture only: the class never contains it.

| File | Source | SHA-256 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `warlock_shiny_animated.svg` (22,733 bytes) | [Provable-Games/beasts-v3](https://github.com/Provable-Games/beasts-v3) at commit `42511842894ef7e98bf0e1c26b0be6f671c3175f`, `assets/examples/warlock_shiny_animated.svg`, copied byte for byte: the Beasts renderer's output for a shiny, animated Warlock | `6ad6b67b75f45d04831c03c9167965c288e5729153a933e9f8c31168421dd658` |

The scores that play with it are synthetic, generated in this repository: see [`tests/fixtures/midi/`](../midi/README.md).
